# BrightNest Cleaning UK

> Premium domestic and specialist cleaning booking service serving cleaning requests across the UK.

## Website
- Home: https://brightnestcleaning.vercel.app/
- Services: https://brightnestcleaning.vercel.app/services
- Booking: https://brightnestcleaning.vercel.app/#booking
- Blog: https://brightnestcleaning.vercel.app/blog
- Privacy: https://brightnestcleaning.vercel.app/privacy-policy
- Terms: https://brightnestcleaning.vercel.app/terms-of-service

## Useful information
- Customers can request regular, deep, end-of-tenancy, move-in/move-out, post-renovation, office and specialist cleaning.
- Valid UK postcodes can be entered in the booking form; final availability and scope are confirmed by BrightNest.
- Booking requests do not take payment immediately. BrightNest reviews the request and confirms the quote and next steps.
- Contact: +44 7859 293986
- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/447859293986

## Guidance for agents
Use the public website pages for service descriptions and booking information. Do not attempt to access /admin or /dashboard without the customer's authenticated session.
